scope: Read-only actual dependency source correction; no builds; frozen original proposal unchanged.
correction: Proposal cited Arrow 58.4.0, which was not the resolved reader dependency: native reader uses 59.3.2; Sail uses 59.2.0. Original source citation is stale; source claims were rechecked in both actual versions below.
conclusion: Both actual versions confirm the cited invariants. GenericByteArray::try_new derives usize entry count from offsets.len()-1 and validates slices/null-count; OffsetBuffer::new requires nonempty nonnegative nondecreasing offsets with no i32 entry-count ceiling; DictionaryArray::try_new bounds checks only valid keys and skips bounds checking if all keys null. GenericStringType<i32> validates whole UTF-8 and all character boundaries/offset bounds. These are source findings, not giant-allocation/runtime claims.

122:     /// Create a new [`GenericByteArray`] from the provided parts, returning an error on failure
123:     ///
124:     /// # Errors
125:     ///
126:     /// * `offsets.len() - 1 != nulls.len()`
127:     /// * Any consecutive pair of `offsets` does not denote a valid slice of `values`
128:     pub fn try_new(
129:         offsets: OffsetBuffer<T::Offset>,
130:         values: Buffer,
131:         nulls: Option<NullBuffer>,
132:     ) -> Result<Self, ArrowError> {
133:         let len = offsets.len() - 1;
134: 
135:         // Verify that each pair of offsets is a valid slices of values
136:         T::validate(&offsets, &values)?;
137: 
138:         if let Some(n) = nulls.as_ref() {
139:             if n.len() != len {
140:                 return Err(ArrowError::InvalidArgumentError(format!(
141:                     "Incorrect length of null buffer for {}{}Array, expected {len} got {}",
142:                     T::Offset::PREFIX,
143:                     T::PREFIX,
144:                     n.len(),
145:                 )));
146:             }
147:         }
148: 
149:         Ok(Self {
150:             data_type: T::DATA_TYPE,
151:             value_offsets: offsets,
152:             value_data: values,
153:             nulls,
154:         })
155:     }
